name: 中央投影片輪播＋左右露出相鄰投影片，下方編號分頁
desc: 一排橫向排列的寬幅圖片輪播，中央投影片約佔畫面寬七成，左右露出相鄰投影片並被畫面邊緣裁切；箭頭疊在相鄰投影片上，下方一排編號分頁。
prompt: 主視覺是一排橫向排列的投影片輪播，投影片列橫跨整個畫面寬，貼齊主視覺上緣與畫面左右邊緣。目前的投影片水平置中，約佔畫面寬的七成；左右兩側各露出相鄰投影片的一部分，被畫面邊緣裁切。每張投影片是一張寬幅的橫式圖片，所有投影片比例相同；圖片上可疊大標題（可多行）與說明文字，位置依每張而定，沒有內容時省略；每張投影片的右下角放一個按鈕。左右兩側各有一個圓形的箭頭圖示按鈕，垂直置中，疊在露出的相鄰投影片靠內側的位置，點擊後切換到上一張或下一張。輪播自動播放，每張停留數秒後整排橫向滑動，讓下一張移到中央，到最後一張後回到第一張繼續；文字和按鈕跟著投影片一起換。
mobile: 底邊改為約在畫面六成高的位置，下方仍露出下一個區塊的開頭。一次只顯示一張投影片，橫跨整個畫面寬，不再露出左右相鄰的投影片；圖片改為接近方形的裁切。按鈕仍在每張投影片的右下角。左右箭頭圖示按鈕從投影片上移到投影片下方的整列，並排放在該列右側。自動輪播與橫向滑動切換保留。

en.name: Centered-slide carousel with side peeks and numbered pagination
en.desc: A horizontal carousel of wide images: the current slide takes about seventy percent of the viewport width, with the neighboring slides peeking in on both sides and cropped by the viewport edges; arrows sit on the peeking slides, and a row of numbered pagination sits below.
en.prompt: The hero is a carousel of slides arranged in a horizontal row; the row spans the full viewport width, flush with the top of the hero and the left and right edges of the viewport. The current slide is horizontally centered and takes about seventy percent of the viewport width; part of each neighboring slide shows on the left and right, cropped by the viewport edges. Each slide is a wide landscape image, and all slides share the same proportions; optionally layer a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) and a description on the image, positioned differently on each slide; omit them when there is no content. Place a button in the bottom-right corner of each slide. On the left and right there is a round arrow icon button, vertically centered, layered over the inner part of each peeking neighboring slide; clicking it moves to the previous or next slide. The carousel autoplays: each slide stays for a few seconds, then the whole row slides horizontally to bring the next slide to the center, and after the last slide it returns to the first and continues; the text and button change together with each slide.
en.mobile: The bottom edge moves to about sixty percent of the viewport height, still revealing the start of the next section below. Only one slide shows at a time, spanning the full viewport width, with no neighboring slides peeking in; the images are cropped closer to square. The button stays in the bottom-right corner of each slide. The left and right arrow icon buttons move off the slides into the full-width row below them, placed side by side at the right end of that row. Autoplay and horizontal sliding are kept.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺底部整列放輪播分頁：一排數字編號，靠左排列，目前的編號以圓圈標示；這一列在投影片下方，不疊在圖片上。
accessories.mobile: 輪播分頁在手機版仍是投影片下方的整列，數字編號靠左，同一列的右側並排放左右切換的箭頭圖示按鈕。

en.prompt: In a full-width row along the bottom of the hero, place the carousel pagination: a row of numbers, aligned left, with the current number marked by a circle; this row sits below the slides, not on the images.
en.mobile: On mobile the carousel pagination stays as the full-width row below the slides, with the numbers aligned left and the left and right arrow icon buttons placed side by side at the right end of the same row.
